items.title: Can Science Disprove Free Will? | Richard Swinburne
items.author: Closer To Truth
items.content:
<article>*If every brain event is caused by a previous brain event, can anyone truly choose?*

Richard Swinburne explains why he rejects determinism, defends libertarian free will, and argues that science cannot prove our choices are merely illusions.

0:00 Why Free Will Matters
1:05 Why Determinism Challenges Moral Responsibility
2:25 Compatibilism vs. Incompatibilism
5:17 Can Intentions Cause Actions?
7:04 Desires, Moral Beliefs, and Choice
11:02 Does Physics Rule Out Free Will?
16:42 Does Free Will Require Dualism?
19:40 Why Science Cannot Disprove Free Will

*Richard Granville Swinburne* FBA is an English philosopher. He is an Emeritus Professor of Philosophy at the University of Oxford. Over the last 50 years, Swinburne has been a proponent of philosophical arguments for the existence of God.

items.title: Woodenfish Forum on Buddhism, Science & Future — Landscape of Consciousness — Robert Lawrence Kuhn
items.author: Closer To Truth
items.content:
<article>*Can your theory of consciousness determine your answers to the biggest questions in philosophy, science, and religion — AI sentience, life after death, free will, personal identity?*

Robert Lawrence Kuhn presents his landmark taxonomy of consciousness theories — spanning materialism, quantum theories, information, panpsychism, dualism, idealism, and more — and argues that every serious question about mind and perhaps even about existence depends on which theory you hold. Recorded at the 7th Woodenfish Forum on Buddhism, Science & Future ("Rewriting Reincarnation in the Light of Frontier Biotechnology"), held at The Grand Hotel, Taipei, June 5–7, 2026, and introduced by the forum's founder, Venerable Dr. Yifa.

Great questions at the end from CTT contributors Max More (on Buddhist consciousness) and, of course, Venerable Yifa.

*Robert Lawrence Kuhn* is the creator, producer, writer, and host of _Closer To Truth,_ the long-running PBS series and global resource on cosmos, consciousness, and meaning. He holds a PhD in anatomy and brain research from UCLA and is the author of "A Landscape of Consciousness: Toward a Taxonomy of Explanations and Implications," editor-in-chief of the Landscape of Consciousness website, which currently catalogues nearly 450 theories of consciousness. The Landscape of Consciousness website: https://loc.closertotruth.com/

*Venerable Dr. Yifa* is the founder and director of the Woodenfish Foundation, an international, nonsectarian nonprofit dedicated to building a global network of ethical and compassionate leaders. A Yale-educated Buddhist nun and Associate at the Harvard University Asia Center, she has appeared on Closer To Truth exploring Buddhist philosophy.

The Woodenfish Forum on Buddhism, Science & Future was founded by Venerable Dr. Yifa with the aspiration of engaging Buddhist thought through the lens of scientific inquiry. The 2026 forum brought together leading scientists, philosophers, and religious thinkers to explore reincarnation, consciousness, and the ethics of frontier biotechnology.
